quest.title: Darknight Hero's Crisis
quest.description: Your inquiries were slowly bringing the Darknight Hero's identity to light, but just then, you met the man himself. His true identity is Diluc, owner of the Dawn Winery — and his actions have long since attracted the attention of the Knights of Favonius...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Mora x13850, Adventurer's Experience x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huffman!

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two. Thank you for coming.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: So — the Darknight Hero. Do you have anything else you're able to share with me?

choices.text: Could I first ask what's going on?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Ah yes, of course I should fill you in first... apologies for my appalling lapse of etiquette.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: The situation is... here. Take a look at this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Geez... what horrible handwriting!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, let me take a closer look... Huh, some parts of this seem to be complete gibberish.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Indeed. Although this is written in the common tongue, it appears that a cipher has been used in many places.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Nevertheless, one can grasp the general message from the non-ciphered portions alone...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: This is a war declaration from the Abyss Order to the Darknight Hero.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean... the bad guys want the Darknight Hero to go away forever and ever?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Something like that. Thus, we are hoping to contact him as soon as possible so that we can attempt to coordinate a response.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: After all, this matter no longer concerns merely the Darknight Hero himself. It impacts the entire city of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: If you find out anything at all, come and find me.

choices.text: I will keep it in mind.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Is that so... That is a pity indeed.

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Master Diluc! Just now we were at the Knights of Favonius and, and—

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I take it you're about to inform me of the war declaration from the Abyss Order?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I am aware of it. Though I appreciate you for taking the trouble to come all this way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The Dawn Winery's intelligence network extends beyond commercial matters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! So, what's the plan, Master Diluc?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I'm open to suggestions...

choices.text: You really should join forces with the Knights...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: No. That would be playing right into the hands of the Abyss Order.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: They know full well that we don't exactly see eye to eye. They're using this as a means to force me into making an appearance.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If my identity were exposed, all my future activities would be subject to some degree of interference from the Knights.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: After all, no powerful organization wishes to be outdone by someone from the outside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... the Abyss Order has really dealt you a tough hand this time. What a sneaky little bunch those guys are!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: There is a way. But for it to work, I need some more information.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Specifically, I need to decipher the obscured portions of the Abyss Order's war declaration.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Obscured portions? You mean the bits Paimon can't read?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: It must be a cipher only understood by members of the Abyss Order, used to spread messages within the organization.

choices.text: Why would they send you a written message that only they can read?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: It's not simply a war declaration, but also a notification to their own.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: When you take a stand that makes you a hero to one party, you also become a villain to the other.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: And since I've been the Abyss Order's enemy for so long...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: They've made me the target around which they can rally their troops and unite their strength.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Seems like it takes a lot of brains to be a superhero, huh?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I understand my enemy well is all. As the saying goes, heroes and villains are two sides of the same coin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what're we gonna do about the intel that's written in gibberish then? How do we... ungibberishify it?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Simple. When you don't understand something, you ask.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I've already tracked down one of their <color=#00E1FFFF>strongholds</color>... If you're interested, feel free to come along.

choices.text: If they knew we can't read it, why did they write it in the first place?
Stay at the winery until this blows over.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That would be tantamount to handing this over to the Knights.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Had they been worthy of this task to begin with, things would never have escalated to this point.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: In any case, circumstances are not dire enough to warrant me going into hiding and leaving the Knights to deal with the consequences.

talks.objective: Talk to Huffman outside the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: How did you find me here!? Favonian scum!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I am no Knight of Favonius. Now, start talking! Your plan, what is it?

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: I see you received our letter... But if you think I'm going to let you in on our secrets, I'm afraid you're quite mistaken!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hmph. You appear to have misunderstood the situation you are in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Burn him with <color=#00E1FFFF>Searing Hand</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: D—Did you just use a Pyro Vision to shoot f—fire from your hands!? ...Aah! It burns!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Let's see how long it takes for you to crack...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Burn him with <color=#00E1FFFF>Searing Hand</color> again!

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: Stop! Stop! P—Please, the pain— I beg you... make it stop!

response.speaker: Abyss Mage
response.text: Ugh...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Playing dead won't help you — that fire was nowhere near strong enough to— Oh... He seems to have <color=#00E1FFFF>passed out</color>...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hey! You sleep when I say you can sleep!

response.speaker: Abyss Mage
response.text: Aah! It burns!

response.speaker: Abyss Mage
response.text: I'll talk, I'll talk! Ow ow ow... P—Please, stop! I'll tell you <color=#00E1FFFF>everything</color>!

response.speaker: Abyss Mage
response.text: Th—The Abyss Order, we've amassed a force bound by a shared hatred for the Darknight Hero...

response.speaker: Abyss Mage
response.text: They... They will march on the Mondstadt <color=#00E1FFFF>city gates</color> at 10 PM tomorrow night.

response.speaker: Abyss Mage
response.text: That's everything I know... Please... Don't make me suffer those flames again...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That's it? Well, I doubt you'd be foolish enough to keep anything else hidden.

choices.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Interrogate him</color> about their plan of attack.

talks.objective: Tell Diluc about the war declaration
Go to the Abyss Order stronghold

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: This is the place.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Abandoned ruins like these are precisely the kind of place the Abyss Order likes to camp out.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Come on. There's no time to lose.

talks.objective: Arrive at the depths of the Abyss Order stronghold
Interrogate the Abyss Mage and find out their plan
Use fire to burn the plan out of the Abyss Mage

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Now that I have the information I need, I must prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I would be grateful if you could keep me updated on how the Knights of Favonius respond to this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, Master Diluc sir! Anything you say, Master Diluc sir!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: ...Why are you acting so strange all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In... in light of what just went down here a moment ago...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Master Diluc has officially reached No. 1 on Paimon's "people not to tick off under any circumstances" list...

talks.objective: Plan your next step with Diluc
Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters
Talk to Huffman about the Knights' situation

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: If we do not make contact with the Darknight Hero soon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are we to do about the Abyss Order's challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two. I must admit, this issue of the Darknight Hero is proving to be something of a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: We've just held a meeting to decide on an appropriate course of action. Can you guess what it is?

choices.text: Bury our heads firmly in the sand?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Haha... Good one. But no, the Knights cannot afford to simply stand by and watch while there is even the slightest inkling of a threat facing Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: If that were the case, more and more people would start to rely on the Darknight Hero instead of the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh. Well, what's the plan then?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Find out the Darknight Hero's true identity, and offer him our protection.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Protection"? He seems to be doing just fine without your protection so far, y'know...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Pff...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Well, since you've aided the Knights in the past, I might as well just tell you.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: The offer of protection is just a ruse, in order for the Knights of Favonius to take over full — and exclusive — responsibility for this matter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You aren't gonna let the Darknight Hero be all heroic and stuff? Why not?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Firstly, to show the might of the Knights of Favonius — to prove to the people that without the Darknight Hero, they can still rely on the Knights to maintain peace and harmony.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Secondly, the Abyss Order have no mercy in their hearts. If anything happened to the Darknight Hero...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: It would only serve to further their nefarious ambitions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Gosh... Paimon never knew the life of a knight involved so much untold anguish before.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: But none of this will work if we don't establish the Darknight Hero's true identity in time.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: There's no need to despair, Huffman. Just follow my plan and everything will be fine.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Ah, Captain Kaeya.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Lately, Master Diluc has been working the bar at the Angel's Share every night.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: All I need you to do is keep him in your sight. Think you can manage that for me?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Yes, Captain Kaeya! ...But, does that mean that...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Master Diluc is the Darknight Hero?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Who knows...? It's just a hunch. I've been known to be wrong on occasion.

choices.text: Join forces with the Darknight Hero?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: No. That would send a signal that the Knights are in favor of the Darknight Hero's continued presence in our city... which we are not.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Encouraging this kind of individual heroism undermines the Knights' authority.
